lesson.subject: data-ai
lesson.title: Paint on a Computer
lesson.summary: Use line, shape, fill, brush and undo tools to make a digital picture.
learning_objectives: Use undo to fix a mistake
Say how digital painting differs from paper painting

standards.text: Use technology purposefully to create, organise, store, manipulate and retrieve digital content
Select and operate appropriate software and hardware to perform a variety of tasks

success_criteria: I can name the line, shape, fill and undo tools
I can fix a mistake with undo
I can say one way digital and paper art differ
lesson.real_life: Making an Eid card, a poster for a school fair or a picture on a family tablet.

warm_up.prompt: What is a bug in a program?
warm_up.explanation: A bug is a mistake in instructions.

blocks.markdown: Today's big question: how do we paint on a screen?
blocks.say: Today we paint with a computer. Zainab is going to make a picture on her tablet.

blocks.alt: A wooden palette covered in pink and orange paint with many brushes
blocks.caption: Real brushes and paint. A paint app has tools too.
blocks.credit: Photo by Jennie Razumnaya on Unsplash
blocks.say: These are real brushes and real paint. Today we paint with tools on a screen.

blocks.markdown: A **digital** picture is made on a computer, not on paper.
blocks.say: Digital means made or shown on a computer. A digital picture lives on a screen.

scenes.caption: Paper: brush and paint.
scenes.say: Zainab can paint on paper. She uses a brush and wet paint.

scenes.caption: Screen: finger and tools.
scenes.say: Or she can paint on a tablet. She uses her finger or a stylus.

scenes.caption: Digital: saved on a computer.
scenes.say: The tablet picture is digital. It can be saved and opened again.

question.prompt: A picture made on a tablet is called...
question.hint: It is made on a computer.
question.explanation: A picture made on a computer or tablet is digital.

blocks.markdown: The **line tool** draws lines. The **shape tool** makes shapes.
blocks.say: A paint app has tools. The line tool draws a line. The shape tool makes a square or a circle.

blocks.markdown: The **fill tool** colours inside. The **undo tool** takes back a step.
blocks.say: The fill tool pours colour inside a shape. The undo tool takes back your last step.

scenes.caption: Line tool.
scenes.say: The line tool draws a straight line across the screen.

scenes.caption: Shape tool.
scenes.say: The shape tool makes a circle, a square or a triangle.

scenes.caption: Fill tool.
scenes.say: The fill tool colours the inside of the shape yellow.

scenes.caption: Undo tool.
scenes.say: Oops, a mistake. Undo takes back the last step.

question.prompt: Which tool colours inside a shape?
question.explanation: The fill tool colours the inside of a shape.

blocks.title: Zainab paints an Eid card
blocks.transcript: Zainab wants to make an Eid card for her cousin. She uses the shape tool to draw a big dome. The fill tool pours dark blue into the sky. She draws a yellow moon and some stars. Oops! She fills the dome pink by mistake. She taps undo. The mistake goes away. She types Eid Mubarak on her card. She saves the card and sends it with her mum's help.
blocks.caption: Zainab paints a mosque skyline and fixes a mistake with undo.

points: Digital means made on a computer
Fill colours inside, undo takes a step back
blocks.say: Let us remember. A digital picture is made on a computer. Tools draw lines and shapes.

options.text: Made or shown on a computer

mini_quiz.prompt: Which tool takes back the last step?
mini_quiz.explanation: Undo takes back the last step.

mini_quiz.prompt: A shape tool can make a circle.
mini_quiz.explanation: The shape tool makes circles and squares.

mini_quiz.prompt: Which tool draws a straight line?

blocks.text: Stop 1: Build a house from shapes

blocks.markdown: Make a picture from **shapes**: a square wall and a triangle roof.
blocks.say: Shapes can build a house. A square is the wall. A triangle is the roof.

scenes.caption: Square wall.
scenes.say: First the shape tool makes a big square for the wall.

scenes.caption: Triangle roof.
scenes.say: Next a triangle on top is the roof.

scenes.caption: Rectangle door.
scenes.say: Last a small rectangle is the door. Then fill in the colours.

blocks.title: Build the house
blocks.goal: Move the shapes into the picture. Use 3 shapes.

question.prompt: Which shape makes a good roof?
question.hint: It has a point at the top.
question.explanation: A triangle makes a sloping roof.

blocks.markdown: Do not start again. Tap **undo** to fix a mistake.
blocks.say: Everyone makes mistakes. Zainab fills the door green by mistake. She taps undo.

scenes.caption: Wrong colour.
scenes.say: Oh no. The door is green. Zainab wanted brown.

scenes.caption: Tap undo.
scenes.say: She taps the undo tool. The last step goes away.

scenes.caption: Fixed.
scenes.say: Now the door is plain again. She fills it brown.

blocks.title: Shape house
materials: A tablet or computer with a paint app
instructions: Draw a square for the wall and a triangle for the roof.
Fill the wall with a colour. Fill the roof with another.
Make a mistake on purpose. Tap undo to fix it.
blocks.say: Now you try at home. Ask a grown-up to open a paint app.

question.prompt: Undo takes back your last step.
question.explanation: Undo takes back the last thing you did.

points: A square wall and a triangle roof make a house
blocks.say: Let us remember. Shapes build pictures. Undo fixes mistakes.

terms.meaning: Takes back your last step.
A flat form like a square, circle or triangle.
A shape with three sides.
A shape with four sides and square corners.
Something that went wrong.
The top of a house.

mini_quiz.prompt: Which shape is a good wall?

blocks.say: A paint app has many tools. Each one has a job. Let us match them up.

scenes.caption: Pencil and brush.
scenes.say: A pencil icon draws a thin line. A brush icon paints soft lines.

scenes.caption: Bucket and shape.
scenes.say: A bucket icon fills. A shape icon makes shapes.

scenes.caption: Undo arrow.
scenes.say: An arrow icon goes back. That is undo.

question.prompt: Which tool paints soft, wavy lines?

blocks.markdown: Play the memory game. Then pick the best tool.
blocks.say: First, a memory game. Then choose the best tool for each job.

question.prompt: Match each job to the best tool.
question.explanation: Fill colours, shape draws shapes and undo takes back.

points: Fill colours inside, shape makes shapes
blocks.say: Let us remember. Pick the tool that fits the job.

terms.meaning: Something that helps you do a job.
A small picture on a screen that you tap.
The picture for the fill tool.
What a tool is for.
Going up and down, like waves.

mini_quiz.prompt: You can use more than one tool in a picture.
Which tool is a bucket icon?
mini_quiz.explanation: The bucket is the fill tool.

blocks.markdown: Plan first. Think about shapes, colours and a message.
blocks.say: Zainab will paint an Eid card for her cousin. First she plans on paper.

blocks.alt: A mosque dome and two minarets in silhouette against an orange sunset
blocks.caption: A dome and minarets at sunset. Zainab uses this idea.
blocks.credit: Photo by Simon Infanger on Unsplash
blocks.say: She wants a dome, a crescent moon and some stars. Domes and moons are shapes.

blocks.markdown: Pick colours that are easy to see together.
blocks.say: She picks dark blue for the sky and yellow for the moon. Those colours are easy to see.

blocks.title: Plan an Eid card
instructions: Draw a small plan of your card.
Write which tools you will use for each part.
Choose colours that are easy to see.
blocks.say: Planning saves time. You know which tools you need.

question.prompt: Put the card steps in order.
question.explanation: We plan, then draw, then fill.

blocks.text: Stop 2: Paint it and compare with paper

blocks.markdown: Use tools to build the picture. Undo fixes mistakes.
blocks.say: Now she paints it on the tablet. She makes a dome with shapes. She fills the sky.

scenes.caption: Draw the dome.
scenes.say: She draws a big dome with the shape tool.

scenes.caption: Fill the colours.
scenes.say: She fills the sky dark blue and the moon yellow.

scenes.caption: Save the card.
scenes.say: She saves the card. A digital card can be sent or printed.

blocks.markdown: Paper and screen are different. Both can make good art.
blocks.say: Paper paint is real and wet. Digital paint can be undone and saved. Both are real art.

question.prompt: What can digital paint do that paper paint cannot?
question.explanation: Digital paint has undo. Paper paint cannot undo.

points: Choose colours that are easy to see
Paper and digital art are both real art
blocks.say: Let us remember. Plan first, then paint. Both paper and digital art are real art.

terms.meaning: A picture or list of what you will make.
A thin curved moon shape.
Look at two things to see what is the same and different.
Keep your work so you can open it later.
A round roof, like half a ball.

mini_quiz.explanation: Different colours are easy to see.
